user.title: Connect to Hauflo
user.description: The pairing code is in Hauflo: your project → «Connect the home» → «Get a code». It works once, for 30 minutes. Enter only the code — the server is picked from it.

data.server: Hauflo server (leave as is — the code picks the server)

reauth_confirm.title: Link the Hauflo agent again
reauth_confirm.description: Hauflo no longer knows this Home Assistant: the agent was unlinked or the project deleted. Get a new code in Hauflo (your project → «Connect the home» → «Get a code»). This entry is updated, no need to remove it.

data.server: Hauflo server (leave as is — the code picks the server)

reconfigure.title: Link to another Hauflo project
reconfigure.description: Get a new code in Hauflo (your project → «Connect the home» → «Get a code»). This entry is updated; the agent's Home Assistant user stays.

data.server: Hauflo server (leave as is — the code picks the server)

ranges.title: Group addresses for Hauflo
ranges.description: Hauflo will send commands only to these KNX group addresses of project «{project}» — the ones its entities write: {ranges}. Remove any Hauflo must not control (a gate, a lock), then continue. You can change this later in the integration's options.

data.ranges: Allowed addresses (1/1/5, a span 1/1/1-21 or a whole group 1/1; comma-separated or one per line)

error.invalid_code: The code is wrong or expired. A code works once, for 30 minutes — get a new one in Hauflo.
error.cannot_connect: Can't reach Hauflo. Check that this Home Assistant has internet access, then enter the code again.
error.https_required: Hauflo's address must be https:// (http only for a local server).

abort.already_configured: Hauflo is already connected in this Home Assistant.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Hauflo agent per Home Assistant: it is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The Hauflo agent is linked again.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Hauflo agent is linked with the new code.

init.title: Hauflo in this home
init.description:
Connected to project «{project}» on {server} — [open Hauflo]({url}).

Hauflo sends KNX commands only to the addresses below. Every address Hauflo asked for is allowed.

data.allow_changes: Allow Hauflo to change this home's setup
data.ranges: Allowed addresses (1/1/5, a span 1/1/1-21 or a whole group 1/1; comma-separated or one per line)

data_description.allow_changes: Off: Hauflo changes nothing in Home Assistant — deploys, dashboards, rooms, KNX entities and backups started by Hauflo are refused. Monitoring, alarms and voice keep working.
data_description.ranges: Remove any Hauflo must not control (a gate, a lock).

init_pending.title: Hauflo in this home
init_pending.description:
Connected to project «{project}» on {server} — [open Hauflo]({url}).

Hauflo sends KNX commands only to the allowed addresses. Hauflo asked for these and waits for your permission: {pending}. They are NOT allowed until you tick them below. Check each one: it may be a gate or a lock. Unticked ones are declined when you save.

data.allow_changes: Allow Hauflo to change this home's setup
data.ranges: Allowed addresses (1/1/5, a span 1/1/1-21 or a whole group 1/1; comma-separated or one per line)

data_description.allow_changes: Off: Hauflo changes nothing in Home Assistant — deploys, dashboards, rooms, KNX entities and backups started by Hauflo are refused. Monitoring, alarms and voice keep working.
data_description.ranges: Remove any Hauflo must not control (a gate, a lock).
data_description.accept_pending: Tick only your own project's addresses. Check each one: it may be a gate or a lock.
